articles.title: Bill Ackman says 2027 will be an amazing year for stocks as wars, inflation ease
articles.summary: Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman said two geopolitical conflicts — the Ukraine-Russia and Iran wars — along with elevated inflation and interest rates are holding back an otherwise "booming market environment." "Once the overhang of the war is done — and it sounds like we're also potentially heading in the right direction with Russia-Ukraine — energy prices could come way down, and obviously that would be very good for inflation and markets," Ackman told CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" on...

articles.title: We're dipping back into the AI trade with our first data center buy in weeks
articles.summary: Following the trade, Jim Cramer's Charitable Trust will own 100 shares of GEV, increasing its weighting in the portfolio to about 2.15% from 1.9%. AI-related semiconductors and industrial stocks are getting hit hard as investors grow increasingly concerned about the source of capital to support the data center buildout.
